definitions.renderSuccess: Visible rendering without an observed terminal error; scientific correctness and learner interactions are not certified.
definitions.firstValidatorPass: First validator outcome; earlier JSON/schema repairs may have occurred. Null means validation was not reached.
definitions.zeroRepairCompletion: Successful result with zero schema repairs, validator returns, and deterministic repairs.
definitions.successfulLatency: Submission to final render, only for PASS rows; P95 is nearest rank; standard deviation is the sample statistic.
definitions.humanPreference: Multiple models can be selected per reviewed ballot; missing answers are excluded, not rejected.
definitions.commonSubset: The same simulations rendered under all seven campaign models.
definitions.fractionalCredit: Each selected model receives 1 divided by the number selected; an analytical tie normalization, not the original rubric.
definitions.provenanceLimit: Human exports do not embed screenshot versions or candidate exposure logs; availability uses these fixed campaign runs.
